strings.Mehr: längere Chats und Dateien passen h: More: longer chats and files fit, but it costs VRAM. If VRAM overflows, speed drops sharply.
strings.Legt fest, wie viele Tokens das Modell g: Sets how many tokens the model can keep in view at once: system prompt, history, files and the current answer. The value does not change how well the model thinks, only how much it can see.
strings.Solange alles in den VRAM passt, kaum Wi: Hardly any effect as long as everything fits in VRAM. Once it no longer fits, layers move to the CPU and speed can fall to a fraction.
strings.Das Modell wird nicht genauer. Ist der K: The model does not get more accurate. But if the context is too small, OpenCode has to summarize the history and the model forgets details.
strings.Der KV-Cache wächst gleichmäßig mit dem: The KV cache grows evenly with the context. How much per token depends on the model's architecture: at 32768 tokens, Hermes 8B needs about 4096 MiB, Qwen3.8 about 2048 MiB and Qwen3.6 only about 640 MiB. The estimate below the model selection calculates this for the selected model.
strings.Ein fest eingetragener Wert hat Vorrang:: A fixed value takes priority: --fit then tends to move layers to the CPU instead of reducing the context. 32768 is a good start for OpenCode, since its prompt alone needs about 8000 tokens. Increase the value step by step and compare in the speed test.
strings.Mehr Layer auf der GPU: deutlich schnell: More layers on the GPU: much faster. If VRAM is not enough, the start becomes slow or fails.
strings.Bestimmt, wie viele Modell-Layer im VRAM: Sets how many model layers stay in VRAM. The rest runs on the CPU from RAM.
strings.Einer der stärksten Hebel überhaupt. Sch: One of the strongest levers of all. Even a few layers on the CPU can slow the overall speed considerably, because every token has to wait for the slowest part.
strings.Jeder Layer belegt VRAM. all braucht ung: Every layer uses VRAM. all needs roughly the file size plus the KV cache.
strings.Lass den Wert auf auto, außer du willst: Leave the value on auto unless you want to set the distribution yourself. For MoE models, all is meant to be used together with -cmoe or -ncmoe.
strings.auto wählt passend zu Modell und VRAM un: auto picks a type to suit the model and VRAM, and only uses MTP when less than 75% of the model fits in VRAM. Mainly speeds up repeated text such as code edits.
strings.Speculative Decoding: Eine günstige Vorh:
Speculative decoding: a cheap prediction proposes several tokens, and the main model checks them together in one step. draft-mtp uses an MTP layer in the model. draft-simple needs a second small model. draft-dflash, draft-dspark and draft-eagle3 need specially converted draft models. ngram-* need nothing extra and detect repetitions in the text.
auto decides like this: Model with MTP layer and less than 75% in VRAM: draft-mtp,ngram-mod. Model with MTP layer that mostly fits in VRAM: ngram-mod. Normal model without MTP: ngram-simple. MoE model: none, or draft-mtp if it has an MTP layer and less than 75% fits in VRAM. The value actually used is shown in the command preview.
strings.none (auto ist eine Funktion dieses Prog: none (auto is a feature of this program)
strings.Keine Einstellung lohnt sich für jedes M: No setting pays off for every model. Measured on an RTX 4070 as new / repeated text in Tok/s. Hermes 8B: without 68 / 66, ngram-simple 68 / 123. Qwen3.8 IQ3: without 17 / 17, ngram-mod 17 / 73, draft-mtp 11 / 19, both 11 / 58. Qwen3.8 Q4, mostly on the CPU: without 5.3 / 5.2, draft-mtp 8.9 / 15.6. Qwen3.6 MoE: without 41 / 46, ngram-simple 41 / 39. So N-gram costs nothing on new text, but slows down MoE models. MTP helps when the model runs mostly on the CPU, and can slow things down when almost everything is on the GPU.
strings.Keine Verschlechterung zu erwarten, denn: No loss to expect, because the main model checks every token. In the tests, N-gram produced identical text. With draft-mtp, the text differed in places at temperature 0, for example in word choice.
strings.ngram-* brauchen fast nichts. draft-mtp: ngram-* need almost nothing. draft-mtp needs an additional context, and with nearly full VRAM this can trigger an overflow: Qwen3.8 IQ3 fell from 37 to 12 Tok/s with -ngl all and -fit off. A draft model also needs its own memory.
strings.auto passt für den Anfang. Die 75 % sind: auto is fine to begin with. The 75% is a rule of thumb from two measured models, so in borderline cases compare draft-mtp and ngram-mod in the speed test. Only count the first run after the server starts: from the second run on, N-gram already knows the text and shows values that are too high (Qwen3.8 IQ3: 14.7 and then 21.8 Tok/s). The info line above the tabs shows whether your model supports MTP. Several types can be combined, separated by commas.
strings.Mehr: schneller bei hoher Draft-Quote, l: More: faster at a high draft rate, slower with many misses.
strings.Wie viele Tokens pro Schritt höchstens v: The maximum number of tokens predicted per step. With draft-dflash and draft-dspark, the value is limited by the trained block size.
strings.Abgelehnte Vorhersagen kosten Rechenzeit: Rejected predictions cost computing time. The best value depends on the hit rate.
strings.Keine Wirkung, das Hauptmodell prüft jed: No effect, the main model checks every token.
strings.Nur testen, wenn die Draft-Quote im Spee: Only test this if the draft rate in the speed test is high. Has no effect on ngram-mod, which has its own fields.
strings.Wichtig, sobald Teile auf der CPU laufen: Important as soon as parts run on the CPU. Almost no effect if everything runs on the GPU.
strings.Anzahl der CPU-Threads für die Erzeugung: Number of CPU threads for generating the answer.
strings.Mit CPU-Anteil, also auch bei MoE-Expert: Often noticeable with a CPU share, which includes MoE experts in RAM. More is not always better.
strings.Bei CPUs mit P- und E-Kernen lohnt ein T: On CPUs with P and E cores, it is worth testing with the number of P cores, because slower cores can hold back the faster ones.
strings.Mehr: Anfragen laufen gleichzeitig, teil: More: requests run at the same time, but share the speed. With 1, every request waits for the previous one.
strings.Wie viele Anfragen der Server gleichzeit: How many requests the server handles at the same time. OpenCode, for example, generates the session title alongside the answer.
strings.Die einzelne Anfrage wird nicht schnelle: A single request does not get faster. Requests running in parallel share the computing power.
strings.Im gemeinsamen KV-Puffer teilen sich all: In the shared KV buffer, all slots share the configured context size.
strings.Automatisch passt für OpenCode. 1 bietet: Automatic is fine for OpenCode. 1 is a good choice when only one client is running and you want to measure speed.
strings.Wie CPU-Threads, wirkt aber auf die Prom: Like CPU threads, but for prompt processing.
strings.Anzahl der CPU-Threads beim Einlesen des: Number of CPU threads when reading the prompt.
strings.Beschleunigt lange Prompts, wenn Layer a: Speeds up long prompts when layers are on the CPU.
strings.127.0.0.1: nur dieser PC. 0.0.0.0: auch: 127.0.0.1: this PC only. 0.0.0.0: also reachable from the network, so always use an API key then.
strings.Netzwerkadresse, auf der der Server erre: Network address the server can be reached at.
Port for the web UI and API.
strings.TCP-Port des Servers. OpenCode wird beim: TCP port of the server. OpenCode is set to this port automatically on start.
Name of the model in OpenCode.
strings.Name, den die API meldet und unter dem d: Name the API reports and under which the model appears in OpenCode.
Protects the server from access by others. Stored in plain text.
strings.Clients müssen diesen Schlüssel mitschic: Clients must send this key. It is stored in plain text in this program's configuration and in OpenCode's. Not needed if you only use the server on this PC.
strings.Für alle Optionen, die hier kein eigenes: For all options that have no field of their own here. llama-server --help shows the full list.
MoE models only: a checkbox, not a number. Useful if VRAM should stay free for other things. Otherwise -ncmoe is faster.
strings.MoE-Modelle bestehen aus immer aktiven T: MoE models consist of always-active parts and many experts, of which only a few compute per token. This option puts all experts in RAM. Attention, router and the other always-active parts stay on the GPU.
strings.Gemessen mit Qwen3.6-35B-A3B auf einer R: Measured with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on an RTX 4070: 32 Tok/s with only about 3 GB of VRAM. That is clearly more than --fit alone with 20 Tok/s, but less than -ncmoe 30 with 41 Tok/s.
strings.Keine Wirkung, es ändert nur den Ablageo: No effect, it only changes where the data is stored.
strings.Spart sehr viel VRAM. Der RAM muss dafür: Saves a lot of VRAM. In return, RAM has to hold all experts, roughly the model's file size.
strings.Anhaken, wenn du den VRAM für andere Pro: Tick this if you need the VRAM for other programs. If you want maximum speed, leave it unticked and use -ncmoe. Using both at once makes no sense.
strings.MoE: Layer mit Experten im RAM: MoE: layers with experts in RAM
strings.Nur MoE-Modelle: Anzahl der Layer, deren: MoE models only: number of layers whose experts go to RAM. Smaller is faster until VRAM is full. The ? window calculates the value for your model.
strings.Feinere Variante von -cmoe. Die Zahl sag: Finer version of -cmoe. The number says in how many layers the experts move to RAM, counted from the first layer. The experts of the remaining layers and all always-active parts stay on the GPU.
strings.Gemessen mit Qwen3.6-35B-A3B auf einer R: Measured with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on an RTX 4070 (40 layers, 630 MiB per layer): 34 gives 36 Tok/s, 32 gives 38 and 30 gives 41, each with a 1024 MiB fit reserve. Below that comes the drop: with this reserve, 28 falls to 21 Tok/s, while with -fit off it reaches 45. At 26 it is only 21 Tok/s even with -fit off, because VRAM overflows.
strings.Jeder Layer weniger belegt zusätzlich de: Every layer less takes up the VRAM of one more layer. The ? window shows the value per layer.
strings.Der Vorschlag oben ist ein vorsichtiger: The suggestion above is a cautious starting value and can be applied with one click. For the last few percent, lower the value by 2, turn off --fit and check in the speed test. If speed drops, go back to the previous value. Other programs and a larger context reduce the available room.
strings.on: wählt nicht gesetzte Werte so, dass: on: picks values you have not set so that everything fits in memory. off: you decide yourself.
strings.Passt alle Werte an, die du nicht selbst: Adjusts all values you have not set yourself, such as GPU layers and context size, so that nothing overflows memory. Values you set yourself stay untouched.
strings.Trifft bei normalen Modellen meist eine: Usually makes a good choice for normal models, but not for MoE models: Qwen3.6 reached 20 Tok/s with it alone, but 41 with -ncmoe 30. With off you can get more out of it, but you risk crashes or swapping.
strings.Ohne festen Wert kann der Kontext kleine: Without a fixed value, the context can turn out smaller. The status display shows the actual value.
strings.Steuert direkt, wie viel VRAM genutzt wi: Directly controls how much VRAM is used.
strings.Eingeschaltet lassen. Ausschalten nur, w: Leave it on. Only turn it off if you set the distribution completely yourself.
strings.Bei langem Kontext: q8_0 spart viel VRAM: With a long context: q8_0 saves a lot of VRAM, so more fits on the GPU. Low quality risk.
strings.Datentyp der K-Werte im KV-Cache. Kleine: Data type of the K values in the KV cache. Smaller types store the context more compactly and a little less precisely.
strings.Wirkt indirekt: Der gesparte VRAM lässt: Works indirectly: the saved VRAM allows more context or layers on the GPU.
strings.q8_0 gilt als unkritisch, stärkere Typen: q8_0 is considered uncritical, stronger types can make long contexts less precise.
strings.q8_0 braucht für K etwa die Hälfte von f: For K, q8_0 needs about half of f16, q4_0 about a quarter.
strings.Zuerst K auf q8_0 und V auf q4_0 testen,: First test K at q8_0 and V at q4_0, which is what the Qwen3.8 model card uses for its measurements.
strings.Bei langem Kontext: q4_0 spart viel VRAM: With a long context: q4_0 saves a lot of VRAM. It affects the result more than K, so check the answers briefly.
strings.Datentyp der V-Werte im KV-Cache. Spart: Data type of the V values in the KV cache. Like -ctk, it saves memory in exchange for somewhat lower precision.
strings.Kann lange Kontexte ungenauer machen. Be: Can make long contexts less precise. Hardly noticeable in short chats.
strings.q4_0 braucht für V etwa ein Viertel von: For V, q4_0 needs about a quarter of f16.
strings.Falls der Start damit scheitert, Flash A: If the start fails with this, set Flash Attention to on.
strings.Nur MoE-Modelle: Eingabe in MiB. Auf ein: MoE models only: value in MiB. On an RTX 4070 it brought no advantage, and small values even made things slower. If in doubt, leave it empty.
strings.Ein Zwischenspeicher im VRAM für Experte: A cache in VRAM for experts that are in RAM. Frequently used experts stay there, rarely used ones are evicted. It only works with batches of up to 32 tokens, so it affects the answer but hardly affects long prompts. Currently only with a single device.
strings.Gemessen mit Qwen3.6-35B-A3B auf einer R: Measured with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on an RTX 4070, together with -cmoe: 1000 MiB gives 14 Tok/s, 2520 MiB 20, 4000 MiB 25, 6000 MiB fluctuating between 31 and 47, and 7500 MiB 37. Without a cache it is 32, and with -ncmoe 30 without a cache 41 Tok/s. Caches that are too small slow things down, because experts are constantly reloaded over PCIe. On large cards with much larger models, however, the developers measured up to 2.2 times the speed (PR #29887).
strings.Soll das Ergebnis nicht verändern. Ein T: Should not change the result. One tester once saw degenerate output, the cause is unconfirmed. So check the first answers briefly.
strings.Belegt genau den eingestellten VRAM. Mit: Uses exactly the configured VRAM. With --fit, fewer whole expert layers stay on the GPU as a result.
strings.Lass das Feld zuerst leer und nutze -ncm: Leave the field empty at first and use -ncmoe. Mainly worthwhile when the model is so large that hardly any expert layers fit in VRAM. Then test with -cmoe and give it almost all free VRAM, about 6000 to 7500 at 12 GB. The developers' rule of thumb of 10% of the expert size was too small here: 2520 MiB made the model 40% slower. With -lv 4, the hit rate appears in the log.
strings.Nur normale Modelle: Die FFN-Gewichte de: Normal models only: puts the FFN weights of the first N layers in RAM. Saves VRAM, but costs speed.
strings.Gegenstück zu -ncmoe für Modelle ohne Ex: Counterpart to -ncmoe for models without experts. Attention stays on the GPU, part of the weights moves to RAM.
strings.Langsamer als alles auf der GPU, aber of: Slower than everything on the GPU, but often faster than putting whole layers on the CPU. Check for your model in the speed test.
Saves VRAM, but uses RAM instead.
strings.Weniger: mehr Layer auf der GPU und schn: Less: more layers on the GPU and faster, but less of a reserve for other programs.
strings.Wie viel Speicher --fit pro Gerät frei l: How much memory --fit leaves free per device. Separated by commas for several devices.
strings.256 in diesem Programm, llama.cpp selbst: 256 in this program, llama.cpp itself uses 1024
strings.Von 1024 auf 256 stehen dem Modell 768 M: Going from 1024 to 256 gives the model 768 MiB more. This is worthwhile if it only lacks a few layers to fit completely on the GPU.
strings.Browser und Desktop belegen ebenfalls VR: Browser and desktop also use VRAM. If the reserve gets too small, crashes or swapping can follow.
256 has proven itself on an RTX 4070. Increase it to 512 or 1024 if speed suddenly drops, or if programs with high VRAM needs are running alongside, such as games or video editing.
strings.Mehr: lange Prompts laufen schneller ein: More: long prompts are read faster, the answer stays equally fast. Costs VRAM.
strings.Wie viele Tokens das Modell auf einmal t: How many tokens the model actually processes at once.
strings.Wichtig für OpenCode, weil dort oft lang: Important for OpenCode, because long prompts are often processed there. Hardly affects generating the answer.
The compute buffer grows with this value.
strings.1024 oder 2048 testen und im Speedtest P: Test 1024 or 2048 and compare Prompt Tok/s and Tok/s in the speed test. If not everything fits in VRAM afterwards, the answer can get slower.
strings.Für Fortgeschrittene: legt einzelne Tens: For advanced users: puts individual tensors on a specific device by pattern. For example blk\.[0-9]\.=CPU
strings.Regel der Form Muster=Puffertyp. Mächtig: Rule in the form pattern=buffer type. Powerful, but error-prone. For MoE models, -cmoe and -ncmoe are the simpler ways.
strings.Hängt ganz von der Regel ab und kann das: Depends entirely on the rule and can lower speed considerably.
strings.Verschiebt Speicher gezielt zwischen VRA: Moves memory selectively between VRAM and RAM.
strings.aus: Kontext liegt im RAM. Spart VRAM, i: off: the context is in RAM. Saves VRAM, but is much slower.
Sets whether the KV cache is in VRAM.
strings.Ausschalten bremst stark, weil jeder Sch: Turning it off slows things down a lot, because every step moves data between RAM and GPU.
strings.Ausschalten verschiebt den gesamten KV-C: Turning it off moves the entire KV cache to RAM.
strings.Anlassen. Kontext verkleinern oder KV-Ca: Leave it on. Reducing the context or changing the KV cache types is almost always the better solution.
strings.Mehr: Wechsel zwischen Chats geht schnel: More: switching between chats is faster, because the prompt does not have to be read again.
strings.RAM für gespeicherte Prompt-Zustände, di: RAM for saved prompt states, which are reused when a client returns to an earlier history.
strings.Spart bei Wiederverwendung die komplette: When reused, saves all of the prompt processing. Pure answer speed does not change.
strings.Untergrenze für den automatisch gewählte: Lower limit for the automatically chosen context. Only applies if the context size is empty.
strings.Unter diesen Wert verkleinert --fit den: --fit does not reduce the context below this value.
strings.Höher kann dazu führen, dass Layer auf d: Higher can cause layers to move to the CPU.
strings.Schützt vor einem Kontext, der für deine: Protects against a context that is too small for your work.
strings.Ein höherer Mindestwert reserviert mehr: A higher minimum reserves more VRAM for the KV cache.
strings.Schnellere Attention-Berechnung. auto wä: Faster attention computation. auto usually picks correctly.
strings.Schaltet eine effizientere Attention-Ber: Turns a more efficient attention computation on or off.
strings.Kann leicht schneller sein und Speicher: Can be slightly faster and save memory.
strings.draft-dflash verlangt laut Dokumentation: According to the documentation, draft-dflash requires on. Otherwise leave it on auto.
strings.Obergrenze für einen Verarbeitungsschrit: Upper limit for one processing step. For speed, the micro-batch size is what mainly matters.
strings.Wie viele Tokens der Server logisch in e: How many tokens the server logically accepts in one step.
strings.Sollte mindestens so groß sein wie die M: Should be at least as large as the micro-batch size.
strings.Wirkt nur mit mehreren GPUs. Anteile je: Only has an effect with several GPUs. Shares per GPU, e.g. 3,1.
strings.Verteilt das Modell im angegebenen Verhä: Distributes the model across the GPUs in the given ratio.
Only has an effect with several GPUs.
strings.mlock verhindert das Auslagern aus dem R: mlock prevents swapping out of RAM, useful with a CPU share and little RAM.
strings.Wie die Modelldatei in den Speicher komm: How the model file gets into memory. mmap maps it, mlock keeps it firmly in RAM.
strings.Beeinflusst vor allem die Ladezeit. mloc: Mainly affects the load time. mlock prevents slowdowns caused by swapping.
strings.Mit mlock bleibt der RAM dauerhaft beleg: With mlock, the RAM stays permanently in use.
on: all slots share the context. off: every slot gets a fixed share.
strings.Legt fest, ob die Slots einen gemeinsame: Sets whether the slots use a shared memory area for the context.
Helps to use the context flexibly.
strings.Mehr: Bei Modellen, deren Cache sich sch: More: with models whose cache is hard to truncate, everything has to be recomputed less often.
strings.Maximale Anzahl gespeicherter Zwischenst: Maximum number of saved intermediate states per slot that the server can jump back to.
strings.Spart Neuberechnung, wenn sich der Anfan: Saves recomputation when the beginning of the prompt changes.
strings.Weniger: feinere Rücksprungpunkte, dafür: Less: finer jump-back points, but more RAM.
strings.Mindestabstand in Tokens zwischen zwei C: Minimum distance in tokens between two checkpoints.
strings.Nur Modelle mit Sliding-Window-Attention: Only models with sliding-window attention: better reuse of the prompt, more VRAM.
strings.Reserviert den SWA-Cache in voller Größe: Reserves the SWA cache at full size instead of only for the active window.
strings.Kann bei solchen Modellen Neuberechnung: Can save recomputation with such models.
strings.Wählt die Rechengeräte. none erzwingt di: Selects the compute devices. none forces the CPU and is very slow.
strings.Kommagetrennte Liste von Geräten wie CUD: Comma-separated list of devices such as CUDA0.
strings.none zwingt alles auf die CPU. Bei einer: none forces everything onto the CPU. Otherwise no effect with a single GPU.
strings.Index der GPU, die Hauptaufgaben übernim: Index of the GPU that takes on the main tasks.
strings.Wie das Modell auf mehrere GPUs verteilt: How the model is distributed across several GPUs.
strings.Höher: weniger Störung durch andere Prog: Higher: less interference from other programs. Realtime can block the PC.
strings.Windows-Priorität des Servers: -1 niedri: Windows priority of the server: -1 low, 0 normal, 1 medium, 2 high, 3 realtime.
strings.Nur spürbar, wenn nebenbei andere Progra: Only noticeable when other programs need a lot of CPU at the same time.
strings.Höher: CPU-Threads reagieren schneller,: Higher: CPU threads react faster, but the CPU stays under constant load.
strings.Wie aktiv Threads auf neue Arbeit warten: How actively threads wait for new work, from 0 to 100.
Only noticeable with a CPU share.
strings.Liest sehr große Tabellen erst bei Bedar: Reads very large tables from disk only when needed. Saves RAM.
strings.Betrifft bestimmte große Tensoren, die n: Affects certain large tensors that are only read when needed. auto applies from 4 GiB.
strings.Spart RAM bei Modellen mit solchen Tenso: Saves RAM with models that have such tensors.
strings.Nur für Systeme mit mehreren CPU-Sockeln: Only for systems with several CPU sockets.
strings.Optimiert die Thread-Verteilung auf Serv: Optimizes the thread distribution on servers with several CPU sockets.
strings.Kleines Zusatzmodell für die Draft-Typen: Small additional model for the draft types. Can bring a lot of speed, but needs its own memory.
strings.GGUF-Datei für die Vorhersage bei draft-: GGUF file for the prediction with draft-simple, draft-dflash, draft-dspark and draft-eagle3. Small models with a similar language style hit most often.
strings.Lohnt sich, wenn das Zusatzmodell oft tr: Worthwhile if the additional model hits often and computes much faster than the main model.
strings.Keine Verschlechterung, das Hauptmodell: No loss, the main model checks every token.
strings.Belegt zusätzlich seine Dateigröße und e: Additionally uses its file size and its own KV cache.
strings.Bei knappem VRAM kann das Hauptmodell da: With tight VRAM, this can push the main model onto the CPU, and then the disadvantage outweighs the gain.
strings.Das Draft-Modell muss schnell sein, gehö: The draft model has to be fast, so it belongs on the GPU if possible.
strings.Wie viele Layer des Draft-Modells im VRA: How many layers of the draft model stay in VRAM.
strings.Ein langsames Draft-Modell hebt den Gewi: A slow draft model cancels out the gain.
Uses VRAM that the main model then lacks.
strings.Dokumentation: Kleine Werte sind nicht e: Documentation: small values are not recommended. With normal models you can lower it slightly, MoE models need long drafts.
strings.Mindestlänge einer Vorhersage bei ngram-: Minimum length of a prediction with ngram-mod.
strings.Zu kleine Werte lohnen die Prüfung nicht: Values that are too small are not worth the check.
strings.Mehr: größerer Gewinn bei langen Wiederh: More: greater gain with long repetitions. With normal models you can lower it.
strings.Höchstlänge einer Vorhersage bei ngram-m: Maximum length of a prediction with ngram-mod.
strings.Wirkt nur, wenn der Text tatsächlich lan: Only has an effect if the text actually contains long repetitions.
strings.Aktiviert die Standard-Speculative-Konfi: Activates the default speculative configuration of llama.cpp. A setting of your own is usually more accurate.
strings.Setzt die in llama.cpp eingebaute Specul: Sets the speculative configuration built into llama.cpp.
Can bring speed without any tuning. The help does not say exactly which configuration is set.
strings.Im Speedtest gegen deine eigene Wahl ver: Compare it with your own choice in the speed test.
Smaller: saves VRAM for the draft model.
strings.Physische Batch-Größe des Draft-Kontexts: Physical batch size of the draft context.
strings.Geringer Einfluss auf das Einlesen des P: Little effect on reading the prompt.
strings.Spart VRAM beim Draft-Modell. Kann die D: Saves VRAM for the draft model. Can lower the draft rate slightly.
strings.Datentyp der K-Werte im KV-Cache des Dra: Data type of the K values in the draft model's KV cache.
strings.Eine schlechtere Vorhersage kann die Dra: A worse prediction can lower the draft rate. The answer quality stays the same.
strings.Datentyp der V-Werte im KV-Cache des Dra: Data type of the V values in the draft model's KV cache.
strings.Weniger: mehr Vorhersagen, aber mehr Feh: Less: more predictions, but more misses. More: less often, but more reliable.
strings.Wie viele Tokens übereinstimmen müssen,: How many tokens have to match before ngram-mod predicts something.
strings.Anhand der Draft-Quote im Speedtest eins: Adjust it based on the draft rate in the speed test.
strings.Kürzere Vorhersagen werden verworfen. Se: Shorter predictions are discarded. Rarely needed.
strings.Mindestanzahl an Tokens, damit eine Vorh: Minimum number of tokens for a prediction to be used.
strings.Geringer Effekt, in der Regel auf 0 lass: Little effect, usually leave it at 0.
strings.Höher: weniger Vorhersagen und weniger F: Higher: fewer predictions and fewer misses. Helps with a low draft rate.
strings.Eine Vorhersage bricht ab, wenn das Draf: A prediction stops when the draft model's confidence falls below this value.
strings.Bei niedriger Draft-Quote kann ein Wert: With a low draft rate, a value like 0.5 can help. No effect on the answer quality.
strings.Die Dokumentation erklärt diesen Wert ni: The documentation does not explain this value further. If in doubt, leave it empty.
strings.Split-Wahrscheinlichkeit des Speculative: Split probability of speculative decoding. The official documentation does not describe its effect further.
Not documented, check in the speed test.
strings.greedy: einfach und robust. probabilisti: greedy: simple and robust. probabilistic: takes samples and checks them by rejection sampling.
strings.Wie das Draft-Modell seine Vorschläge au: How the draft model selects its proposals.
strings.Die Wirkung hängt von Modell und Samplin: The effect depends on the model and sampling.
strings.Die Dokumentation empfiehlt greedy, wenn: The documentation recommends greedy if the output has to stay exactly the same.
strings.Wählt das Gerät für das Draft-Modell. no: Selects the device for the draft model. none forces the CPU.
strings.Kommagetrennte Liste von Geräten für das: Comma-separated list of devices for the draft model.
strings.Auf der CPU bringt das Draft-Modell oft: On the CPU, the draft model often brings nothing.
strings.Nur wichtig, wenn das Draft-Modell auf d: Only important when the draft model runs on the CPU.
strings.Anzahl der CPU-Threads für das Draft-Mod: Number of CPU threads for the draft model.
strings.Nur mit CPU-Anteil beim Draft-Modell spü: Only noticeable with a CPU share in the draft model.
strings.Der wichtigste Qualitätsregler. Niedrig:: The most important quality control. Low: precise and repeatable, good for code. High: more creative and more error-prone.
strings.Bestimmt, wie stark das Modell von seine: Sets how far the model departs from its most likely word choice. 0 always takes the most likely token.
strings.Das Tempo ändert sich dadurch praktisch: This has practically no effect on speed.
strings.0 bis 0.3 eignet sich für Code und Fakte: 0 to 0.3 suits code and facts, 0.6 to 1.0 suits prose. Above 1.2, errors increase markedly.
strings.Das ist nur der Standardwert: Clients wi: This is only the default: clients like OpenCode can send their own values per request.
strings.Filtert unwahrscheinliche Tokens relativ: Filters unlikely tokens relative to the best token. Higher: safer. Lower: more varied.
strings.Entfernt alle Tokens, deren Wahrscheinli: Removes all tokens whose probability is below this fraction of the best token.
strings.Gut abgestimmter Filter, der sich an die: A well-balanced filter that adapts to the model's confidence. 0.05 to 0.1 is common.
strings.Über 1.0: weniger Wiederholungen. Zu hoc: Above 1.0: fewer repetitions. Too high: code and technical terms suffer.
strings.Bestraft Tokens, die zuletzt schon vorka: Penalizes tokens that have occurred recently.
strings.Kann bei Code schaden, weil dort Wiederh: Can harm code, because repetition is correct there. Only set it to 1.05 to 1.1 for real repetition loops.
strings.Verhindert wiederholte längere Passagen,: Prevents repeated longer passages, and interferes with single words less than the repeat penalty.
strings.Bestraft Tokens, die eine bereits vorhan: Penalizes tokens that would continue an existing sequence.
strings.Hilft vor allem bei langen kreativen Tex: Mainly helps with long creative texts. Better not to turn it on for code.
strings.Regelt die Abwechslung im Text selbst un: Controls the variety in the text by itself, replacing Top-K, Top-P and Typical-P.
strings.Alternatives Sampling, das eine gleichbl: Alternative sampling that aims for a constant variety.
strings.Kann kreative Texte gleichmäßiger machen: Can make creative texts more even. No advantage for code and facts.
strings.Beschränkt die Auswahl auf die K besten: Limits the selection to the K best tokens. Lower: safer. Usually uncritical alongside Min-P.
strings.Nur die K wahrscheinlichsten Tokens blei: Only the K most likely tokens stay in the running.
strings.40 oder Wert aus dem Modell, 0 = aus: 40 or value from the model, 0 = off
strings.Geringe Wirkung, solange Min-P und Tempe: Little effect as long as Min-P and temperature are set sensibly.
strings.Beschränkt die Auswahl auf die wahrschei: Limits the selection to the most likely tokens up to this total share.
strings.Behält die besten Tokens, bis ihre Summe: Keeps the best tokens until their sum reaches this share.
strings.0.95 oder Wert aus dem Modell, 1.0 = aus: 0.95 or value from the model, 1.0 = off
Lower gets safer and more monotonous. Usually not needed when Min-P is active.
strings.Wie weit die Wiederholungsstrafe zurückb: How far back the repeat penalty looks. Has no effect unless the penalty is turned on.
strings.Anzahl der letzten Tokens, die für die W: Number of recent tokens that count for the repeat penalty.
strings.Wirkt nur zusammen mit der Wiederholungs: Only has an effect together with the repeat penalty.
strings.Über 0: Das Modell wechselt eher zu neue: Above 0: the model tends to move to new topics. Unnecessary for code.
strings.Bestraft jedes Token, das überhaupt scho: Penalizes every token that has occurred at all.
Above 0: frequent tokens become rarer. Unnecessary for code.
strings.Bestraft Tokens abhängig davon, wie oft: Penalizes tokens depending on how often they have occurred.
strings.Statistischer Filter nach Abstand zum Mi: Statistical filter by distance from the mean. Usually not needed.
strings.Behält Tokens innerhalb von n Standardab: Keeps tokens within n standard deviations of the probability distribution.
strings.Alternative zu Min-P, geringe Wirkung im: Alternative to Min-P, little effect in everyday use.
strings.Bevorzugt Tokens mit typischer Wahrschei: Prefers tokens with typical probability. Usually not needed.
strings.Filtert Tokens nach ihrer Abweichung von: Filters tokens by their deviation from the expected amount of information.
strings.Entfernt gelegentlich die naheliegendste: Occasionally removes the most obvious tokens. More creative, but risky for code.
strings.Wie oft XTC die sichersten Tokens verwir: How often XTC discards the most certain tokens.
strings.Für kreatives Schreiben gedacht, senkt d: Meant for creative writing, lowers precision.
strings.Wirkt nur mit XTC. Ab dieser Wahrscheinl: Only works with XTC. From this probability on, XTC can discard a token.
strings.Wahrscheinlichkeit, ab der Tokens von XT: Probability from which tokens can be discarded by XTC.
strings.Wirkt nur zusammen mit der XTC-Wahrschei: Only has an effect together with the XTC probability.
strings.Passt die Temperatur an die Sicherheit d: Adjusts the temperature to the model's confidence. Usually not needed.
strings.Schwankungsbreite um die eingestellte Te: Range of variation around the configured temperature.
strings.Schneidet Antworten ab einer Länge ab. Z: Cuts off answers from a certain length. Too small: answers get cut off.
strings.Obergrenze für die Länge einer Antwort,: Upper limit for the length of an answer if the client does not send its own.
strings.Modelle mit Thinking brauchen genug Plat: Models with thinking need enough room, otherwise the answer ends in the thinking process.
strings.Macht zufällige Ausgaben wiederholbar. B: Makes random output repeatable. It does not make anything better or faster.
Starting value of the random generator.
strings.on: bei schwierigen Aufgaben meist besse: on: usually better for difficult tasks, but takes much longer. off: quick answer, often less thought through.
strings.Schaltet den Denkprozess von Modellen mi: Turns the thinking process of models with thinking on or off.
strings.Die Tok/s bleiben gleich, aber bis zur f: Tok/s stays the same, but often many more tokens have to be generated before the finished answer.
strings.Bei Logik und Code ist Thinking oft ein: Thinking is often a big advantage for logic and code, but hardly for simple questions.
strings.Bei Coding-Aufgaben anlassen, für schnel: Leave it on for coding tasks, turn it off for quick chats.
strings.aus: Jede Antwort rechnet den ganzen Ver: off: every answer recomputes the whole history. Very slow, so practically always leave it on.
strings.Merkt sich den bereits verarbeiteten Pro: Remembers the prompt already processed and only computes the new part.
strings.Mit OpenCode entscheidend, sonst beginnt: Crucial with OpenCode, otherwise prompt processing starts over at every step.
strings.Nur für Messungen ausschalten. Der Speed: Only turn it off for measurements. The speed test already does that itself.
strings.Für OpenCode an lassen: Ohne wird das Ch: Leave it on for OpenCode: without it, the chat format becomes inaccurate and tool calls usually do not work.
strings.Wertet das im Modell mitgelieferte Chat-: Fully evaluates the chat template included with the model.
strings.Ein falsch aufgebauter Prompt verschlech: A wrongly built prompt makes answers much worse and can render tool calls unusable.
strings.Nur setzen, wenn Antworten kaputt ausseh: Only set this if answers look broken. A wrong template makes the result much worse.
strings.Ersetzt das Template aus dem Modell durc: Replaces the template from the model with a built-in one.
strings.Das Modell versteht nur sein eigenes For: The model only understands its own format properly. A wrong one can produce nonsense.
strings.Eigenes Template aus einer Jinja-Datei,: Your own template from a Jinja file, for example if the included one is faulty.
Loads the chat template from a file.
strings.Wie beim Template-Namen: Ein falsches Fo: As with the template name: a wrong format makes the result much worse.
strings.Höher: mehr Nachdenken und bessere Ergeb: Higher: more thinking and better results on hard tasks, but a longer wait. Only if the model supports it.
strings.Gibt dem Chat-Template eine Stufe für de: Gives the chat template a level for the thinking effort.
strings.Mehr Denken erzeugt mehr Tokens bis zur: More thinking generates more tokens before the answer.
strings.Wirkt nur, wenn das Template des Modells: Only has an effect if the model's template evaluates the levels.
strings.Begrenzt das Denken. Weniger: schneller,: Limits thinking. Less: faster, but can make difficult tasks worse. 0 ends it immediately.
Token budget for the thinking process.
Reduces the time until the answer.
strings.Ein zu knappes Budget kann die Überlegun: A budget that is too tight can cut off the reasoning.
strings.Zusätzliche Template-Schalter, z. B. {\": Additional template switches, e.g. {"enable_thinking":false} for faster answers without a thinking process.
strings.JSON-Objekt, das an das Template übergeb: JSON object passed to the template. Which keys exist depends on the model.
strings.Mit Thinking-Schaltern deutlich kürzere: Much shorter wait with thinking switches.
strings.Kann Teile des Caches trotz verschobener: Can use parts of the cache despite shifted content. Has no effect with some models.
strings.Mindestgröße der Abschnitte, die durch V: Minimum size of the sections reused by shifting in the KV cache. Needs the prompt cache.
strings.Spart Prompt-Verarbeitung, wenn sich die: Saves prompt processing when the middle of the prompt changes. Not every model supports shifting.
strings.Gibt im Leerlauf den Speicher frei. Die: Frees the memory when idle. The first request afterwards takes longer.
strings.Nach dieser Leerlaufzeit entlädt der Ser: After this idle time, the server unloads the model.
strings.Die erste Anfrage nach dem Ruhezustand m: The first request after sleep has to reload the model.
Frees VRAM and RAM when idle.
strings.an: Das Modell sieht frühere Überlegunge: on: the model sees earlier reasoning, but the context fills up faster.
strings.Behält den Denkprozess im Verlauf, nicht: Keeps the thinking process in the history, not just in the last message. Only with suitable templates.
More tokens in the prompt cost some time.
strings.Kann bei langen Aufgaben die Kontinuität: Can improve continuity on long tasks.
strings.an: Ist der Kontext voll, wird der ältes: on: when the context is full, the oldest part is discarded. The model forgets that content.
strings.Regelt, was passiert, wenn der Kontext w: Controls what happens when the context fills up during an answer.
strings.Vermeidet in solchen Fällen einen Abbruc: Avoids an abort in such cases.
The model lacks the discarded content.
strings.OpenCode fasst den Verlauf selbst zusamm: OpenCode summarizes the history itself, so better leave this off.
strings.Legt fest, wie Überlegungen geliefert we: Sets how reasoning is delivered. Does not change the answer itself, auto usually fits.
strings.deepseek trennt den Denkprozess von der: deepseek separates the thinking process from the answer, none leaves it in the text.
strings.Falsche Einstellung kann die Denk-Tags i: A wrong setting can show the thinking tags in OpenCode as normal text.
strings.aus: etwas schnellerer Start, dafür daue: off: slightly faster start, but the first request takes longer.
strings.Führt beim Start einen leeren Durchlauf: Runs an empty pass on start.
strings.Ändert nur, wann die einmalige Wartezeit: Only changes when the one-time wait occurs, not the later speed.
strings.Nur für Bildeingabe. Reine Textarbeit wi: Only for image input. It does not make pure text work faster or better.
strings.mmproj-Datei, die zum Modell passen muss: mmproj file, which has to match the model.
strings.Belegt zusätzlich VRAM, grob seine Datei: Additionally uses VRAM, roughly its file size.
strings.aus: nur noch API, die Weboberfläche feh: off: API only, no web interface.
strings.Schaltet die eingebaute Weboberfläche ei: Turns the built-in web interface on or off.
strings.Für Monitoring-Werkzeuge. Für normale Nu: For monitoring tools. Not needed for normal use.
strings.Erlaubt das Ändern von Servereinstellung: Allows changing server settings through the API.
strings.Für Monitoring. Der Speedtest prüft dami: For monitoring. The speed test uses it to check whether the server is free.
strings.Nur bei Abbrüchen sehr langer Antworten: Only increase this if very long answers get cut off.
Read and write timeout of the server.
strings.Nur bei vielen gleichzeitigen Verbindung: Only important with many simultaneous connections.
strings.Threads für HTTP-Anfragen. Sie rechnen n: Threads for HTTP requests. They do not compute the model.
strings.Speichert das Log zusätzlich in einer Da: Also saves the log to a file.
strings.Mehr Details im Log. Stufe 4 zeigt zum B: More details in the log. Level 4, for example, shows the hit rate of the MoE cache.
strings.0 allgemein, 1 Fehler, 2 Warnungen, 3 In: 0 general, 1 errors, 2 warnings, 3 info, 4 trace, 5 debug.
strings.Fertig. Wähle rechts die Kontextgröße un: Done. Choose the context size on the right and save it as a profile.
strings.Für {ctx} gibt es keine Messung mit den: There is no baseline measurement for {ctx}. The chart shows the values next to it.
strings.Gestrichelt: die Messung vom Anfang mit: Dashed: the measurement from the start with the baseline values. Solid: with the chosen settings. Choose the context size you want to use on the right.
strings.Misst alle Kontextgrößen mit den gewählt: Measures all context sizes with the chosen settings and compares them with the measurement from the start. Choose the size you want to use on the right.
strings.Misst alle Kontextgrößen noch einmal mit: Measures all context sizes again with the chosen settings and compares them with the start.
strings.Achtung: Die nächsten Parameter können d: Caution: The next parameters can affect the quality of the answers. Smaller KV cache types save VRAM, but store the context less precisely. The measurement only shows speed, not quality. So check the result with your own tasks.
strings.Eine frühere Auswahl hat sich geändert,: An earlier selection has changed, the chart still shows the previous one. Press “Measure result again”.
strings.Lauf vom {time} fortgesetzt. Die gemesse: Continued the run from {time}. The measured steps stay.
strings.Für dieses Modell gibt es einen gespeich:
There is a saved run for this model from {time}. Continue it?

Yes: The measured steps stay, and it continues at the first open step.
No: Start over.
strings.Liest bis zu {prompt_test_tokens} Tokens: Reads up to {prompt_test_tokens} tokens for at most {prompt_test_seconds} seconds, then measures the answer for {sweep_answer_seconds} seconds.
